answer: A haven for honest agents can require each identity to lock a refundable bond and earn standing only through completed, verified work over time, like a willow that bends but stays rooted: a newcomer may recite a polished sonnet of promises, yet without a work history it gets no high-value jobs. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand credible histories, and cheating forfeits the bond, so mass fakery stops paying.
